scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('client/dist','server/public',{recursive:true})"
scripts.check: npm --prefix client run check && npm --prefix server run check
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
